description: This file contains the implementation of a generic validator class for Attribute objects in the OpenMRS system. It enforces validation rules such as non-null attributeType, owner, and value, and validates the attribute's data type using CustomDatatypeUtil.

classes.name: BaseAttributeValidator
classes.description: A validator class for attributes, supporting null checks and datatype validation, implementing Spring's Validator interface.

methods.name: supports
methods.description: Checks if the class supports validation for the given class type, specifically Attribute class or its subclasses.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Performs validation on the target attribute object, checking for null attributeType, owner, and value, and validating the value's datatype.
